provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Descent: Legends of the Dark rulebook (Fantasy Flight Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Launch the app, "New Game": choose a save slot, difficulty and heroes
steps.note: Only the save slot is permanent

steps.text: Single player: choose and control two heroes
Each hero: reference card, health dial, figure, hero card and two starting weapons
steps.note: Brynn: Warden's Blade + Weighted Warhammer; Galaden: Bloodwood Bow + Mirror Blades; Syrus: Crook'd Staff + Glimmering Wand; Vaerix: Ironthorn Warbell + Riverwatch Spear

steps.text: Stack the two weapons with the upgrade-icon faces together, sleeve them as one attack card
Hero card and attack card may start on either side
Health dial to the maximum health on your hero card
Tokens sorted by type into piles
Map tiles, terrain, enemy figures, consumable and injury cards (unshuffled) in the supply
Return all other cards to the box for the first quest
Start the quest in the app and build the map it shows
